query:
UPDATE factory_step
            SET machine_id = NULL,
                slot_wait_since = COALESCE(slot_wait_since, now()),
                slot_wait_machines = $3,
                slot_wait_reason = $4
            WHERE run_id = $1 AND seq = $2 AND ended_at IS NULL
            RETURNING now() - started_at > make_interval(secs => $5) AS "late!"
